# MikroTik MCP Server

> Open-source Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that lets Claude and other AI assistants monitor and configure MikroTik RouterOS routers through the RouterOS REST API (v7) or binary API (v6/v7). TypeScript, Node.js 20+, MIT license.

Key facts:
- Repository: https://github.com/RexGuard/MikroTik-MCP
- Transports: REST API over HTTPS (RouterOS 7.1+), binary API on ports 8728/8729 (RouterOS 6 and 7)
- Clients: Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf, any MCP client (stdio)
- Safety: read-only mode (MIKROTIK_READ_ONLY=true), per-device readOnly, destructive tools annotated, reboot requires confirm=true
- Multi-router: MIKROTIK_CONFIG or MIKROTIK_DEVICES JSON array; every tool accepts an optional `device`
- It does not run inside the RouterOS console; it runs on a computer that can reach the router

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/RexGuard/MikroTik-MCP/blob/main/README.md): install, router preparation, configuration, Claude setup, FAQ
- [Example multi-device config](https://github.com/RexGuard/MikroTik-MCP/blob/main/examples/devices.example.json)

## Tools

- mikrotik_list_devices: configured routers
- mikrotik_system_overview: identity, version, board, CPU/RAM/disk, uptime, clock, health, packages
- mikrotik_interfaces, mikrotik_ip_addresses, mikrotik_routes, mikrotik_firewall_rules, mikrotik_dhcp_leases, mikrotik_wireless_clients, mikrotik_arp_table, mikrotik_logs: read state
- mikrotik_ping, mikrotik_traceroute: diagnostics from the router
- mikrotik_firewall_add_rule, mikrotik_address_list, mikrotik_backup, mikrotik_reboot: common changes
- mikrotik_print, mikrotik_add, mikrotik_set, mikrotik_remove, mikrotik_set_enabled, mikrotik_run_command: any RouterOS menu or command
